title: Samples, samples, and more samples
text: So this box has been getting worse each month, also my August/September box was never delivered but I was charged. Second time contacting this company to receive a snarky response email. Anyway, even the samples have been junky or the box has arrived with majority sheet masks that break me out. This November box had nothing in it that is pictured above as the “November Box.” Also everything is sample sized! Who is able to use sample size shampoo and conditioner this tiny, and decide if it works or not? At least the vitamin c was a good addition. So sadly I’m finally canceling my beauty box. Hopefully the rumor that Nordstrom is thinking of doing a beauty box will come true.
label: negative
